title: Code Factory: Proof-by-Sabotage Software Factory
description:
Code Factory is a proof-first, open-source software factory for turning specifications, behavior checks, design contracts, policy verification, Mermaid diagrams, and release receipts into auditable delivery through Unified Graph Ops. It retains resume parity checks for sealed agent-transition lineages and a Survival Card for bounded recovery context. Version 0.42.0 adds a human-declared, hash-bound Change Profile to Engineering Judgment. It compares explicit change kinds with independently promoted decision Capsules, exposes novel declared boundaries and decision drift, and routes routine, domain, specialist, or architecture attention without inspecting source semantics. Guardian Core retains bounded local aggregate heap, process-CPU-when-available, indexing, and EDT dispatch observations in the JetBrains plugin without changing settings or diagnosing causes. The local MCP surface and Graph Ops inspect existing receipts without gaining write or execution authority. Release media includes the current FactoryLine identity asset and real product captures.

Evidence boundary: declared attention is review context, not approval, safety, compliance, or production readiness. The project does not expose raw state, prompts, or secrets; inspect source semantics to infer a profile; grant execution outside a named admitted local E2E batch; repair, approve, merge, publish, deploy, sign, access credentials/connectors, or send external messages; or estimate time, token, cost, quality, or productivity savings. A passing receipt proves only the supplied sealed transitions and declared checks.
